mentions.name: Unit Separated Values
mentions.description: A specification and companion tools for a unit-separated values data format that uses Unicode control characters as delimiters instead of commas, created as an alternative to the problems of CSV.
mentions.problem: CSVs have widely complained-about shortcomings, and the author set about creating a spec and tools around Unicode control character delimiters in response to repeated HN posts and comments about CSVs sucking.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've see so many HN posts and cmments about CSVs sucking and Unicode control characters as delimiters, that I set about creating a spec and some tools for use with it.
